title: ModelSpec
description: Complete pre-fit description of a model. Tagged union on model_type. See 02-modelling.md §4.4.
$comment: Amended 2026-08-22 (W5, the contract-reconciliation slice), when the existence check first learned to read `if`/`then` branches and this schema could be compared at all. Until that date the guard raised `KeyError: 'properties'` here — the generated counterpart is a discriminated `oneOf` with no top-level `properties` — so nothing had ever compared either arm. Kept flat-plus-`if`/`then` rather than rewritten as a `oneOf`: the authored half exists to be read by a person, and the two arms read better beside their common block than as three duplicated objects. Five resolutions, each the code's (CLAUDE.md §0): (1) the nested `regularisation` block is deleted for `GlmSpec`'s flat `alpha`/`l1_ratio`/`select_by`/`cv`, which OQ-MODEL-8 records as `corrected in place` and FR-MODEL-87 lists as `present under a different shape`; (2) `backend` is deleted — `model_type` is the backend, and two fields holding one fact can disagree with nothing able to say which to believe; (3) `base_margin` is deleted — FR-MODEL-27 has the platform construct it from the declared `offset`, and what was constructed is recorded on the fit result where FR-MODEL-71 asserts it at load time; (4) `link` loses `power` and `response` loses `elasticity`, neither of which any type has ever admitted; (5) `categorical_handling` is `native | factor_encoding`, not `native | grouping | one_hot`. The `ebm` arm is new: `model_type` has admitted `ebm` since Phase 0 with no branch to match it, so every EBM spec validated against this contract with zero field-level checking.

split_ref.description: Optional here and required to reach `fitted`: FR-MODEL-54 makes a diagnostic without its holdout counterpart a defect, so the obligation sits on the Model, where the status is.

response.description: Optional because every spec written before the custom-objective slice declared only the column; required whenever the objective is a Custom Objective, where FR-MODEL-44's applicability check has nothing to read without it.

factors.description: UNRECONCILED (W5, 2026-08-22): this shape and §4.4's example both pin a Factor by version; `ModelSpecCommon.factors` is `tuple[UUID, ...]` and carries no version. Neither side is edited to match the other pending a decision — see CLAUDE.md §0.

loss_treatment.description: FR-MODEL-73. In the spec rather than beside it because it changes the model's identity: two models differing only in a cap must not collide on `spec_hash` (FR-MODEL-66).

filter.description: DECLARED AND UNBUILT (FR-MODEL-87, owner Phase 1b). No `model_schema` type carries this field; it is named here rather than dropped so the staging record survives.

family_params.description: `tweedie` carries its fixed power here as `power`, 1 < p < 2. To estimate the power instead, declare `tweedie` below (FR-MODEL-22).

alpha.description: FR-MODEL-20's elastic-net penalty strength. Pinned to 0 under `select_by: cv`, where the effective penalty comes from `cv.alphas`.

tweedie.description: FR-MODEL-22: estimate the Tweedie power by profile likelihood over this grid. Estimation paired with CV alpha selection is refused by name.

approximates_model_id.description: FR-MODEL-96 — the Model whose predictions this GLM approximates. Null for every model fitted on an observed response.

approximates_model.description: FR-MODEL-129 — the companion address, set iff `approximates_model_id` is set (OQ-MODEL-43 decided (a)). The id is the lookup key; this is how the Model is addressed for reading, following `interval_for`'s slug@version shape with the id left out.

custom_objective_ref.description: DECLARED AND UNBUILT (FR-MODEL-87, owner W30 — Phase 2, reassigned 2026-08-22 and confirmed 2026-08-25 to reach this field and its `Model` twin). `GlmSpec` carries no such field; `ObjectiveBackend.glm` exists so an author can narrow applicability to a backend nothing reaches yet.

offset_acknowledgement.description: FR-MODEL-27's escape hatch: a counting objective with no offset is refused unless this says why.

monotone_constraints.description: FR-MODEL-28. `derived_from_factors` reads each Factor's monotonic direction; the resulting vector is persisted on the fit result beside the feature order.

hyperparameters.description: `max_depth`, `eta`, `subsample`, `num_boost_round` and the rest. Integers stay integers: both backends reject a float where they want an int.

backend_params.description: The backend-specific escape hatch (`tree_method`, `boosting_type`, …), namespaced so FR-MODEL-25's single contract does not fork into two.

interval_for.description: FR-MODEL-78/100. Set only on a model that is itself a quantile bound; null on every other GBM.

then.description: FR-MODEL-37. Added 2026-08-22 (W5): `ebm` was in `model_type`'s enum from Phase 0 with no branch, so a malformed EBM spec validated here with no field-level checking at all.

objective.description: The only objectives `interpret`'s regressor exposes, both under an identity link. §7's families and binomial `log_loss` are refused by name (FR-MODEL-87).

interactions.description: 0 = univariate terms only; 1 = all pairs. 2 (triples) is declared-and-unbuilt: the grid grows cubically and the JSONB fit result cannot bound it.

max_bins.description: A power of two — `interpret` bins on a dyadic grid. Capped at 256 when `interactions > 0`, where a pair grid is ~8 MB per pair.

monotone_constraints.description: Direction per factor slug: -1 decreasing, 0 none, 1 increasing. Partial maps are allowed here and coverage is checked at fit time (`EBM_MONOTONE_CONSTRAINT_INCOMPLETE`).

offset_model_ref.description: FR-MODEL-24: the pinned model whose linear predictor is the offset. Set iff `kind == 'model'`.

TweediePowerSpec.description: FR-MODEL-22's profile-likelihood grid for the Tweedie power.

ApproximatedModel.description: FR-MODEL-129 — the Model a surrogate GLM approximates, addressed the way a human reads it (slug@version), with the id deliberately absent: the id stays the lookup key.

GbmFunctionRef.description: A builtin objective or eval metric by name, or an approved Custom Objective / Custom Metric by reference. One shape for both because FR-MODEL-26 and FR-MODEL-45 declare the same choice twice.
GbmFunctionRef.required_note: builtin ⟹ name and no ref; custom ⟹ ref and no name.

name.description: `count:poisson`, `reg:gamma`, `reg:tweedie`, `binary:logistic`, … Not an enum: the eval-metric vocabulary is the backend's and differs between them.

EarlyStopping.description: FR-MODEL-30. There is no `train` value, and that is the requirement rather than an oversight: a stopping rule read off the data being fitted stops when the model has finished memorising.

IntervalFor.description: FR-MODEL-78/100 — the central Model this bound estimates a quantile of, and which quantile.

LossTreatment.description: FR-MODEL-73 — how large losses are treated as the model is fitted. A modelling decision, not a property of the data.
